mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users (id, user_name, rank_code, zip_code, address, phone_number) VALUES (#{id}, #{userName}, #{rankCode}, #{zipCode}, #{address}, #{phoneNumber}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE user_name = VALUES(user_name)
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET user_name = #{userName}, zip_code = #{zipCode}, address = #{address}, phone_number = #{phoneNumber} WHERE id = #{id}
